maxZoom.description:
The maximum amount to allow zooming in.
Must be a number greater than 0.

minZoom.description:
The minimum amount of zoom to allow (.1 = 1/10th scale)
Must be a number greater than or equal to 0. Having it equal 0 will mean there is no min zoom.

zoomMultiplier.description:
The zoom multiplier where newScale = oldScale * zoomMultiplier for zooming in and
oldScale / zoomMultiplier for zooming out

title: Type representing the configuration of zooming in a {@link UiSdlDiagramViewer}
name: UiSdlDiagramViewerZoomConfig
